book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Learning about Trade and Economy 学习贸易与经济
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 2 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、贸易/经济主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: China's foreign trade has grown quickly in recent years.
words.example_cn: 近年来中国的对外贸易增长迅速。

words.example_en: A strong economy creates more jobs for ordinary people.
words.example_cn: 强劲的经济能为普通人创造更多就业机会。

words.example_en: China has made great economic progress over the years.
words.example_cn: 多年来中国取得了巨大的经济进步。

words.example_en: Many companies invest in new technology in order to grow.
words.example_cn: 许多公司投资新技术以求发展。

words.example_en: Foreign investment has helped this poor region develop.
words.example_cn: 外来投资帮助这个贫困地区发展起来。

words.example_en: China's imports of goods have risen almost every year.
words.example_cn: 中国的商品进口几乎逐年增长。

words.example_en: These products are mainly made for export to other countries.
words.example_cn: 这些产品主要为出口到其他国家而生产。

words.example_en: The shop sells all kinds of merchandise from abroad.
words.example_cn: 这家商店销售各种各样的进口商品。

words.example_en: Cheap goods from China are sold all around the world.
words.example_cn: 来自中国的廉价商品销往世界各地。

words.example_en: All imported goods must be checked by customs first.
words.example_cn: 所有进口商品都必须先经过海关检查。

words.example_en: The report gives clear statistics about world trade.
words.example_cn: 报告给出了关于世界贸易的清晰统计数字。

words.example_en: The company's annual sales reached a new high last year.
words.example_cn: 公司去年的年度销售额创下新高。

words.example_en: Trade between the two countries grows on a yearly basis.
words.example_cn: 两国之间的贸易逐年增长。

words.example_en: The huge trade deal was worth several billion dollars.
words.example_cn: 这笔庞大的贸易协议价值数十亿美元。

words.example_en: New roads can boost trade in poor mountain areas.
words.example_cn: 新修的道路能促进贫困山区的贸易。

words.example_en: Lower taxes may stimulate the economy and create jobs.
words.example_cn: 降低税收可能刺激经济并创造就业。

words.example_en: Foreign trade can generate millions of jobs for a country.
words.example_cn: 对外贸易能为一个国家创造数百万就业岗位。

words.example_en: Last year, the country's exports exceeded all earlier records.
words.example_cn: 去年该国的出口超过了以往所有记录。

words.example_en: Rich markets absorb much of the poorer nations' exports.
words.example_cn: 富裕市场吸纳了较贫穷国家的大量出口产品。

words.example_en: It is hard to sustain such fast growth for many years.
words.example_cn: 如此快速的增长很难维持很多年。

words.example_en: These figures represent a large part of world trade.
words.example_cn: 这些数字相当于世界贸易的很大一部分。

words.example_en: Innovation in trade models has changed the way we shop.
words.example_cn: 贸易模式的创新改变了我们的购物方式。

words.example_en: Cross-border e-commerce is growing very fast in China.
words.example_cn: 跨境电子商务在中国发展得非常快。

words.example_en: Selling online is a new mode of doing business.
words.example_cn: 网上销售是一种新的经商方式。

words.example_en: Sales this season were higher than in the previous year.
words.example_cn: 本季的销售额高于前一年。

words.example_en: The number of outbound tourists has risen sharply.
words.example_cn: 出境游客的数量急剧上升。

words.example_en: The company hopes to sell more in overseas markets.
words.example_cn: 公司希望在海外市场卖出更多产品。

words.example_en: Foreign trade has brought new jobs to this region.
words.example_cn: 对外贸易为这个地区带来了新的就业机会。

words.example_en: Trade has helped lift millions of people out of poverty.
words.example_cn: 贸易帮助数百万人摆脱了贫困。

words.meaning_cn: (从困境中)摆脱出来;显现;露出
words.example_en: Many families have emerged from poverty in recent years.
words.example_cn: 近年来许多家庭已摆脱了贫困。

words.example_en: The country has reached a level of moderate prosperity.
words.example_cn: 这个国家已达到小康（适度繁荣）的水平。

words.example_en: Trade has a strong effect on people's daily lives.
words.example_cn: 贸易对人们的日常生活有很大影响。

words.example_en: The bank will release a report on economic growth tomorrow.
words.example_cn: 银行明天将发布一份关于经济增长的报告。

words.example_en: The world is still recovering from the financial crisis.
words.example_cn: 世界仍在从金融危机中恢复。

words.example_en: The deal helped establish a new trade partnership.
words.example_cn: 这笔交易帮助建立了一种新的贸易伙伴关系。

words.example_en: Buyers often opt for cheaper goods when prices rise.
words.example_cn: 价格上涨时，买家往往选择更便宜的商品。

words.example_en: We weigh the costs and benefits before every purchase.
words.example_cn: 每次购买前我们都会权衡成本与收益。

words.meaning_cn: 各种不同的;各种各样的
words.example_en: Trade affects various sectors of the whole economy.
words.example_cn: 贸易影响着整个经济的各个部门。

words.example_en: You can transfer money to the seller online in seconds.
words.example_cn: 你可以在网上几秒内把钱转给卖家。

words.example_en: The firm wants to extend its market to other countries.
words.example_cn: 这家公司想把市场扩展到其他国家。

words.example_en: We should lay a firm foundation for future growth.
words.example_cn: 我们应为未来的发展打下坚实的基础。

words.example_en: An improvement in trade brought more jobs to the town.
words.example_cn: 贸易的改善给小镇带来了更多就业。

words.meaning_cn: 雄心勃勃的;有抱负的;宏大的
words.example_en: The country has an ambitious plan for economic growth.
words.example_cn: 这个国家有一个雄心勃勃的经济增长计划。

words.example_en: The Chinese economy has undergone great changes.
words.example_cn: 中国经济经历了巨大的变化。

words.example_en: Exports account for a large share of the country's total.
words.example_cn: 出口在该国总量中占很大份额。

words.example_en: On average, trade grew by about ten percent each year.
words.example_cn: 平均而言，贸易每年增长约百分之十。

words.example_en: Retail sales rose for six months in a row this year.
words.example_cn: 今年零售额连续六个月上升。

words.example_en: China has tried hard to speed up its trade reform.
words.example_cn: 中国努力加快其贸易改革。
